20261122-physics-e4-1.steps.0.explain: If you use lever, you fit reduce di size of force, but di distance wey your hand must move go increase by di same amount, so di total work wey dem do dey conserved (principle of work).
20261122-physics-e4-1.steps.0.hints.0: When you gain for force as you dey use lever, you go lose for distance.
20261122-physics-e4-1.steps.0.hints.1: For physics, dem dey call dis 'principle of work'.
20261122-physics-e4-1.steps.0.options.0.text: Di distance wey di hand must move go increase
20261122-physics-e4-1.steps.0.options.1.text: Di distance wey di hand must move go reduce too
20261122-physics-e4-1.steps.0.options.2.text: Di distance no go change at all
20261122-physics-e4-1.steps.0.options.3.text: E go lift by itself even if you no move your hand

20261122-physics-e4-2.title: Why e dey easier to push
20261122-physics-e4-2.topic: Why e dey easier to push
20261122-physics-e4-2.goal: Apply principles of Why e dey easier to push to solve the reasoning problem.
20261122-physics-e4-2.material: Why e dey easier to push heavy load for cart wey get wheels pass to just drag am for ground?
20261122-physics-e4-2.thinking.0: Why e dey easier to push
20261122-physics-e4-2.s.s1.prompt: Why e dey easier to push heavy load for cart wey get wheels pass to just drag am for ground?
20261122-physics-e4-2.s.s1.explain: If you use wheel, di sliding friction between di ground and di object go change to much smaller rolling friction, so di friction force wey dey block motion go reduce plenty.
20261122-physics-e4-2.s.s1.hint.0: Compare di friction wey dey form when object dey slide with di friction wey dey form when wheel dey roll.
20261122-physics-e4-2.s.s1.hint.1: Rolling friction of wheel small well well.
20261122-physics-e4-2.s.s1.o.o0: Because as di wheel dey roll, di 'rolling friction' for di contact surface dey much smaller than sliding friction
20261122-physics-e4-2.s.s1.o.o1: Because di wheel dey reduce di mass of di load to 1/10
20261122-physics-e4-2.s.s1.o.o2: Because Earth gravity disappear on top di wheel
20261122-physics-e4-2.s.s1.o.o3: Because di ground dey push di wheel forward
